TITLE: Slayer's Dave Lombardo Shares Opinion on Metallica's Lars Ulrich POST: I'm not a musician so bear with me here. Why the constant debate about Lars' skills? If a successful band in any genre was based only on the very best technical players there would only be a handful of bands out there to listen to right? POST: It is fair to say that Lars, in the grand scheme of heavy metal drummers, ranks lower when it comes to technical skills, especially compared to the likes of Lombardo or Menza, and his drumming has only gotten lazier and sloppier with time. However, the drumming on the first four albums, especially AFJA, was pretty solid. The fact is, Lars is responsible for some of the most memorable drum parts in metal (like the machine gun double bass part in One) and he is absolutely indispensable to the songwriting process with James. Lars, Kirk and even Cliff have all been criticized for their technical skills, but their creativity, along with James (who is an excellent songwriter and rhythm guitarist), was what made Metallica the greatest metal band of all time, not their chops.
